steps.title: Anesthetize rabbits for MRI
steps.instruction: At 8 weeks post‑induction, inject each rabbit intramuscularly with xylazine hydrochloride at 10.0 mg per kg body weight.

steps.title: Acquire MRI of femoral condyles
steps.instruction: Place the anesthetized rabbit in a Siemens Skyra 3.0 T MR scanner and acquire T1‑weighted images (TR 634 ms, TE 47 ms) and T2‑weighted images (TR 3000 ms, TE 71 ms) with FoV read 70 mm, FoV phase 100 %, slice thickness 2.0 mm, voxel size 0.2 × 0.2 × 2.0 mm³, and base resolution 320.

steps.title: Sacrifice rabbits at scheduled times
steps.instruction: Euthanize rabbits at the following intervals after induction: 2 weeks – 3 model rabbits; 6 weeks – 3 normal and 3 model rabbits; 12 weeks – 3 normal and 6 model rabbits. Record any deaths (at 3 days and 10 weeks) and exclusions (paralysis of lower extremities).

steps.title: Fix femoral condyles in PFA
steps.instruction: Immerse harvested femoral condyles in 4 % (w/v) PBS‑buffered paraformaldehyde (PFA) until fixed.

steps.title: Micro‑CT scanning and analysis
steps.instruction: Scan fixed condyles on a Skyscan1172 (Bruker) using a 9 µm camera pixel size, 27.22 µm pixel size, 80 kV, 100 µA; acquire data at 0.6° steps over a 180° angular range with 666 rows and 1000 columns; reconstruct with NRecon software using a 192.60° reconstruction angle; generate 3‑D images with CT‑vox version 3.1.1; set the region of interest as cancellous bone of 5.2 mm diameter; calculate percent bone volume (BV/TV, %), trabecular number (Tb.N, mm⁻¹), trabecular thickness (Tb.Th, mm), and trabecular separation (Tb.Sp, mm) using CT‑An version 1.15.4.0.

steps.title: Decalcify, embed, and section bones
steps.instruction: Decalcify harvested bones in 10 % (w/v) EDTA solution, embed in paraffin blocks, and cut sections 5 µm thick.

steps.title: H&E stain bone sections
steps.instruction: Stain the 5 µm sections with hematoxylin and eosin for each predetermined time point (2, 6, 12 weeks).

steps.title: Immunohistochemistry for OCN and Runx2
steps.instruction: At 12 weeks, incubate sections with primary antibodies against osteocalcin (OCN) and runt‑related transcription factor 2 (Runx2), followed by appropriate secondary detection.

steps.title: Statistical analysis of results
steps.instruction: Express data as mean ± SD; compare groups using one‑way ANOVA and Student’s t‑tests in GraphPad Prism version 6.01; consider *P < 0.05, **P < 0.01, ***P < 0.001, ****P < 0.0001 as significant.

steps.title: Record survival and validation data
steps.instruction: Calculate the animal survival rate (86.67 %); note that two model rabbits died at 3 days and 10 weeks and one was excluded for paralysis; report model‑building success rate (83.33 %); confirm successful osteonecrosis at 2, 6, 8, 10, and 12 weeks post‑injection by histopathology, imaging, and hematological analyses.
